title: Glowing crown
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF7C2' stop-opacity='0.95'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#FFD84D' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFB300' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='gold' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE873'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#FFC61A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E89B00'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='goldLight' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF6C0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD94F'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='46' ry='40' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- crown band -->
  <path d='M24 68 L76 68 L78 82 Q50 88 22 82 Z' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <rect x='24' y='64' width='52' height='7' rx='3' fill='url(#goldLight)'/>

  <!-- crown points -->
  <path d='M24 66 L20 40 L34 52 L50 30 L66 52 L80 40 L76 66 Z' fill='url(#gold)'/>

  <!-- highlight edges on points -->
  <path d='M20 40 L34 52 L50 30 L66 52 L80 40' fill='none' stroke='#FFF4B8' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- jewels -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='74' r='5' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='74' r='2.2' fill='#FFC2CE'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='75' r='3.6' fill='#4DD8FF'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='75' r='3.6' fill='#4DD8FF'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='58' r='3' fill='#B45CFF'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='58' r='3' fill='#B45CFF'/>

  <!-- point tips -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='39' r='4' fill='url(#goldLight)'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='39' r='4' fill='url(#goldLight)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='29' r='4.5' fill='url(#goldLight)'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M88 22 L89.5 26 L93.5 27.5 L89.5 29 L88 33 L86.5 29 L82.5 27.5 L86.5 26 Z' fill='#FFFBE0'/>
  <path d='M12 24 L13 27 L16 28 L13 29 L12 32 L11 29 L8 28 L11 27 Z' fill='#FFFBE0'/>
  <path d='M74 14 L74.8 16.2 L77 17 L74.8 17.8 L74 20 L73.2 17.8 L71 17 L73.2 16.2 Z' fill='#FFFBE0'/>
</svg>
